articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.snippet: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.snippet: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: U.S. SEC begins prepping for around-the-clock trading that crypto treats as the norm
articles.snippet: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission dug into plans for around-the-clock trading in an event on the same morning it approved tokenized securities.

articles.title: Clarity Act failure may hamper U.S. crypto as industry seeks legal clarity elsewhere
articles.snippet: The U.S. is likely to lose out to foreign markets in the short term, but SEC and CFTC rules will help underpin the industry.

articles.title: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
articles.snippet: Building on its recent market-data investment in Kaiko, S&P Global’s latest purchase targets the technological risks facing banks and asset managers onchain.
